author: rogersason
quote:
All style, no substance.

​GTA 6 is the complete opposite of what made the previous games great. Visually, it’s stunning, but great graphics can't carry a shallow story.

​The core issue is the forced partnership with Lucia. She comes across as constantly rude and disrespectful, and the game gives you no option to cut ties with her. Instead of an engaging criminal rise, the storyline feels like a string of tedious chores for an unlikeable partner. Neither protagonist saves it: Jason has a dull personality, and both characters lack real depth or progression.

​People play GTA to escape daily life, not to clock out of real-world jobs and avoid difficult people just to do virtual chores. Give us brotherhood, action, and a compelling narrative instead of this.
